method: Bounding-box and computed-style measurements from isolated Chromium sessions.

findings.evidence: 390x844 and 1440x900 both have scrollWidth equal to clientWidth; Learn/Review cards remain a paired action band.
findings.observed: Home mobile content inset is approximately 20–23px; desktop action cards are approximately 624px wide with a consistent gap.
Recall decision controls are 112x74px each; AudioButton is 95x44px; detail primary continuation is 350x48px; no horizontal overflow at 390px.

findings.evidence: Vocabulary, Word Detail, Settings, Weak Words and Dictation measurements
findings.observed: 390px pages use a 366px content frame; shared PageHeader uses margin-bottom 24px and gap 17px; long settings/detail pages scroll vertically without horizontal overflow.

followUps.title: Validate actual browser zoom separately
followUps.observed: A CSS zoom:2 stress signal produced 640px document width inside a 390px viewport; this is not equivalent to browser page zoom and is not a release failure.
followUps.disposition: Keep as a follow-up measurement before any layout change; do not fix from this signal alone.
